scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend "npm --prefix backend run dev:demo" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix frontend && npm ci --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run check:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run check:shared && npm --prefix backend test
